title: [grafana/grafana] Fix issue #130829: variable-backed field override regex
description:
Fix GitHub issue #130829 in grafana/grafana:
https://github.com/grafana/grafana/issues/130829

Repo: https://github.com/grafana/grafana

Implement support for Grafana dashboard variables inside the field-override matcher regex used by “Field with name matching regex”, so a pattern such as ^${chrome_target_version}.* is expanded and applied correctly. Keep the change scoped to the override matcher/variable interpolation path, preserve existing literal-regex behavior, and add focused regression coverage for a variable-backed regex and an ordinary regex.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change in grafana/grafana, not analysis only.
- An upstream pull request against grafana/grafana linked to issue #130829.
- Tests and testing notes with the relevant commands.
- Submit the commit hash, upstream PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.

PR requirements:
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot.
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must include the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job.
- The PR must clearly reference https://github.com/grafana/grafana/issues/130829.

Concrete PR mention requirement: mention openjobs.bot and the exact listing ID or URL after this job is created.
